subject: Mobile Development
title: The App Gold Rush
description: A quick win: understand The App Gold Rush.

hook.text: In 2009, a fart sound app made $10,000 a day. The app gold rush had begun.

buildup.text: Solo developers quit their jobs to build apps. Some became millionaires overnight.

discovery.text: Tiny studios created hits: Angry Birds, Doodle Jump, WhatsApp — all started as small teams.

twist.text: As competition grew, the odds of a solo hit dropped. Marketing costs exploded.

climax.text: The gold rush created an industry but left most developers earning less than minimum wage.

punchline.text: A few struck gold; most found only dust.

quiz.question: What was the app gold rush?
options: A period when solo developers could make fortunes from simple apps
